headline: Mooring and Stonecradle Flare as Expanse Quiets
war_summary: Since the afternoon edition the centre of action has shifted to Mooring County and Stonecradle, while the former leaders have paused. Mooring County records three changes in two hours and seven on the day about Wiccwalk and the Wind Hills, latest near filing, standing twelve Warden holdings after more than eight thousand Colonial and seven thousand Warden casualties on the day. Stonecradle stirs anew with two changes in two hours and nine on the day about World's End, the Cord and the Heir's Knife, latest within two hours, standing six Warden to three Colonial, with day casualties above five thousand Colonial and seven thousand Warden and hourly rates accelerating. Linn Mercy adds two changes in two hours and seven on the day about Outwich Ranch and Lathair, standing one Warden to ten Colonial. Stlican Shelf counts one change in two hours and twenty-five on the day about the Old Mourn and Pale House, standing seven Warden to two Colonial. Fisherman's Row with thirty-nine changes on the day and Weathered Expanse with forty-three show no change in two hours, the latter last turning at the hour of the previous filing, while Marban Hollow also shows no change in two hours after five in six about Mox.
